messages:
katie-f: Hey team — received an escalation from a customer (Vendor: LenderCorp). Their AP system rejected our invoice PDF and they also had a card decline earlier this week. Putting notes here and tagging @raj-s for billing format / @mike-t for payments. Link to sample PDF: https://s3.redwood.internal/invoices/rc-4492.pdf :warning:

raj-s: thanks. quick summary of failure from customer: 'PDF missing legal entity tax id in header, PO number present in visual footer only, address lines concatenated, line items collapsed into a single description'. they pasted their AP reject code: ERR_AP_402.

katie-f: exact message from the bank (merchant): `card declined - insufficient_funds` on 2026-11-05 for payment attempt id `pay_9a8b7c`. customer says the invoice shows the PO in the bottom-right footer and their ERP doesn't parse footers.

mike-t: for the card decline — we should see gateway logs. I pulled the payment attempt and it shows 3DS failed on auth stage. Not sure if related to invoice format, but worth flagging.

nina-support: customer also sent a screenshot of AP import mapping. they require these fields as discrete PDF blocks: legal name, legal address (street / city / postal / country separate), VAT/Tax ID, PO number (top header or billing block), and per-line: qty, unit price, tax amount. They said our PDF merges address lines and puts tax id in a small footer.

billing-bot: webhook payload for invoice rc-4492 (truncated):
```
{
  "invoice_id": "rc-4492",
  "customer": "LenderCorp",
  "po_number": "PO-7721",
  "billing_address": "120 Market St, Suite 8, San Francisco, CA 94103",
  "legal_entity": "Redwood Inference, Inc.",
  "tax_id": "",
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "Model inference - monthly", "amount": 12000 }
  ]
}
```

raj-s: critical detail: `tax_id` is empty in the payload. older AP providers will reject on blank tax_id even when VAT not applicable. Also our PDF generator is swallowing the PO into a floating footer element when the billing block is short. That explains ERP not seeing PO.

katie-f: customer insists PO must be machine-readable in top billing block. They can't move forward with payment reconciliations until PDF updated. Can we produce a repro and patch plan?

mike-t: repro steps for payments side: 1) attempt card capture with gateway X using stored card token -> 2) gateway returns `insufficient_funds` then `3ds_required` then final decline. separate from PDF but triggers retry workflow which then fails. I'll open a ticket with payments team.

raj-s: repro steps for PDF: 1) generate invoice via /v1/invoices with a short billing address and po_number present -> 2) our HTML->PDF layout engine collapses billing block and moves floating footer containing `PO-xxxx` to bottom -> 3) run their AP parser and it returns ERR_AP_402. Quick local test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoices -d '{"customer":"LenderCorp","po_number":"PO-7721","billing_address":"120 Market St, Suite 8, San Francisco, CA 94103","line_items": [{"desc":"inference","qty":1,"unit":12000}] }'
```

nina-support: temporary workaround shared with customer: include PO in `notes` field which surfaces in billing block (they accepted manual CSV mapping) but need permanent fix by EOD.

katie-f: proposed fix: ensure invoice renderer enforces a canonical billing block schema: separate address lines, explicit tax field placement, and move PO to top-right header when `po_number` present. Priority: P1 for finance.

raj-s: I'll prep a PR to the PDF templates to 1) always render `legal_entity.tax_id` (even if blank show 'N/A' with metadata warning), 2) force PO into header slot, 3) split address into lines. estimate 3-4 dev hrs + QA.

mike-t: payments ticket #PAY-1229 opened for the decline pattern, not related to PDF but flagged as customer pain.

nina-support: I've notified account management and legal (they want audit trail). Customer agreed to pause payments until we deliver updated PDF sample.

katie-f: thanks. @raj-s can you drop a sample patched PDF to this thread when done so I can send to customer? :thumbsup:

raj-s: will do. posting ETA and PR link in next message.

katie-f: moving to follow-up. Closing notes: block causes = (1) missing tax_id in payload, (2) PO in footer not parsed, (3) card decline separate but increases friction. We'll resolve PDF first.
